digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter — summary write and recovery
propositions: Execute one ACLI process per Cloud summary write invocation with POSIX process-group and non-POSIX child cleanup preservation.

Thread per-call retry policy from _rest_urlopen_with_retry through _direct_rest_get to get_issue_by_rest, defaulting to three attempts with 2s/5s backoff, with summary recovery selecting one-attempt/no-sleep policy only.

All unrelated REST callers (get_issue_property, search_user_by_email, transitions, issuelinks, PUT/POST helpers) retain three-attempt/2s/5s waits and omit policy argument; existing get_issue_by_rest consumers outside jira/ adapter omit policy argument and remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Classify auth, TLS, permission, and invalid requests as permanent; eligible network, 429, and retryable 5xx outcomes return metadata to shared budget without local replay.

Emit exactly one redacted completion log per terminal or exhausted outcome with logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and message capped at 512 Unicode code points; whole log capped at 1,024 Unicode code points; operation diagnostics at most eight entries with redacted messages.
Summary recovery performs one primary-store REST request with no inner sleep or JQL before any ambiguous replay.
